PRIVATE EVENTS & BUYOUTS

Corporate outings, birthday blowouts, team building and everything in between — court time, food and drink handled in one place.

Build your estimate Just ask us

THE EVENING

Play first, then feast.

Every event we run splits in two. Guests arrive to a bar and a court, and finish around a table. Nobody stands in a corner holding a drink wondering what happens next.

01

Act one

Courts & cocktails

The bar opens as guests arrive. Pros run games and drills across your courts while anyone taking a break heads for the yard games. Paddles and instruction are included — nobody sits out.

02

Act two

The private back room

The group moves through to a reserved room for a full sit-down or buffet service, with its own bartender. Mains, sides, and a dessert station, finished with a toast.

RUN OF SHOW

What an evening looks like

A three-hour evening for a corporate group, as an example. Yours gets built around your headcount and your start time.

  1. First 30 min

    Arrival & welcome

    Bar opens, welcome amenity, guests get their paddles.

  2. Hours 1–2

    Pickleball with the pros

    Drills, games and a mini-tournament across your courts. Yard games running alongside.

  3. From hour 2

    Dinner service

    Full buffet or plated service in the private room — mains, sides and salads.

  4. Last 30 min

    Dessert & toast

    Dessert station, a toast, and awards for whoever won the tournament.

DRINKS

Open bar, all night.

Imported and domestic beers, sparkling, white and red wine, spirits, mocktails and soft drinks. Bartenders on the floor through the event, plus a private bartender in the back room when you have it.

Bundled into the per-guest rate rather than billed separately, so the number you agree is the number you pay.

THE SPACE

Courts, and a room of your own

Exclusive courts

Private court time for the length of your event, with pros running games and a mini-tournament if you want one.

Yard games

Cornhole and lawn games for anyone taking a break from the paddle.

Private back room

A reserved room for dinner, with its own bartender and space to decorate however you like.

PRICED PER PERSON

Packages

Pick a food package and a bar package. That is the whole price — court time is included, and the estimator will do the arithmetic for you.

Food Packages

ELEVENO offers four food packages:

  • Baseline$30/pp
  • Mid-Court$40/pp
  • The ELEVENO$50/pp
  • Morning Serve$25/pp

All include Appetizers, Handhelds, Flatbreads and Dips, replenished for two hours.

Beverage Packages

Three packages are available:

  • The Courtsidefrom $25 / 2hrs
  • The Match Point With House Spiritsfrom $35 / 2hrs
  • The Championship With Premium Spiritsfrom $45 / 2hrs

Drink tickets or a consumption bar are also available.

Food Add-Ons

Signature Salad Bar, Charcuterie & Cheese Board, and New England Seafood Tower.

Drink Add-Ons

Custom Welcome Cocktails and Mocktails, and a Mobile Courtside Bar.

All packages include court time. Prices are per person and exclude state sales tax and service fees.

ON THE COURTS

Put a pro on your court

Certified pros run drills, games and a mini-tournament across your courts. They keep everyone moving and everyone playing, whatever the mix of experience in the room — most groups have never held a paddle and that is exactly the point.

Paddle rental included for every guest. Coaching is charged per pro per hour and quoted with your estimate.

CUSTOM TEAM SWAG

Everyone takes the court in style

Send your group home with something. We produce it in your branding, not ours.

More than just pickleball

With premier courts, signature food and beverage, and flexible event spaces, every detail is designed to make your event seamless and unforgettable.
